name: MotherDuck
summary: Run DuckDB queries on MotherDuck and load Parquet partitions into MotherDuck tables. Loads are idempotent by partition and revision (ADR 0012).

fields.name: motherduck_token
fields.label: MotherDuck access token
fields.help: Create it in the MotherDuck app under settings; store it with ogun secrets set.

settings.name: database
settings.label: Database
settings.help: The MotherDuck database to attach, as in md:<database>.

egress.note: MotherDuck hosts are taken to lie under motherduck.com; narrow the list once the exact names are recorded from a real connection.

operators.summary: Run a SQL query on MotherDuck and keep the result as Parquet.
Insert Parquet rows into a MotherDuck table, once per partition and revision.

notes: For a local DuckDB file use the DuckDB connector and the builtin duckdb@1 operator; this connector is only for the hosted service. extensions.duckdb.org is where DuckDB fetches its MotherDuck extension.
